p.i: A vision of Joseph Smith Jr. & Sidney Rigdon, 16 February 1832, given in Portage County, Hiram Township, State of Ohio, in North America which they saw concerning the church of the Firstborn and concerning the economy of God and his vast creation throughout all eternity.

chapter.li: LEChapter76 Verse1 Hear, O ye Heavens, and give ear, O earth, and rejoice ye inhabitants thereof, for the Lord, he is God and beside him there is none else. VerseEnd Verse2 For great is his wisdom, marvelous are his ways, and the extent of his doings none can find out. VerseEnd Verse3 His purposes fail not, neither are there any who can stay his hand. VerseEnd Verse4 From eternity to eternity he is the same and his years never fail. VerseEnd

Verse5 I, the Lord, am merciful and gracious unto them who fear me, and delight to honor them who serve me in righteousness and in truth unto the end. VerseEnd Verse6 Great shall be their reward and eternal shall be their glory, VerseEnd Verse7 and unto them will I reveal all my mysteries, yea, all the hidden mysteries of my kingdom. From days of old and for ages to come will I make known unto them the good pleasure of my will, concerning all things pertaining to my kingdom. VerseEnd Verse8 Yea, even the wonders of eternity shall they know, and things to come will I shew them, even the things of many generations. VerseEnd Verse9 Their wisdom shall be great and their understanding reach to Heaven, and before them the wisdom of the wise shall perish and the understanding of the prudent shall come to naught. VerseEnd Verse10 For by my spirit will I enlighten them and by my power will I make known unto them the secrets of my will, yea, even those things which eye has not seen, nor ear heard, nor yet entered into the heart of man. VerseEnd

Verse11 We, Joseph Smith Jr. and Sidney Rigdon, being in the spirit on the sixteenth of February, in the year of our Lord one thousand eight hundred and thirty-two, VerseEnd Verse12 and by the power of the spirit our eyes were opened and our understandings were enlarged, so as to see and understand the things of God, VerseEnd Verse13 even those things which were from the beginning, before the world was, which were ordained through his Only Begotten Son, who was in the bosom of the Father even from the beginning, of whom we bear record. VerseEnd Verse14 And the record which we bear is the fullness of the gospel of Jesus Christ, who is the Son, whom we saw and with whom we conversed in the Heavenly vision. VerseEnd Verse15 For while we were doing the work, we came to the twenty-ninth verse of the fifth chapter of John [John 5:5], which was given unto us as follows, speaking of the resurrection of the dead, VerseEnd Verse16 concerning those who shall hear the voice of the Son of Man and shall come forth: VerseEnd Verse17 they who have done good, in the resurrection of the just, and they who have done evil, in the resurrection of the unjust. VerseEnd

Verse18 Now this caused us to marvel, for it was given unto us of the spirit. VerseEnd Verse19 And while we meditated upon these things, the Lord touched the eyes of our understandings and they were opened, and the glory of the Lord shone round about VerseEnd Verse20 and we beheld the glory of the Son on the right hand of the Father and received of his fullness, VerseEnd Verse21 and saw the holy angels and they who are sanctified before his throne worshiping God and the Lamb, who worship him for ever and ever. VerseEnd

Verse22 And now, after the many testimonies which have been given of him, this is the testimony, last of all, which we give of him: that he lives. VerseEnd Verse23 For we saw him, even on the right hand of God, and we heard the voice bearing record that he is the Only Begotten of the Father, VerseEnd Verse24 that by him, and through him, and of him the worlds are and were created, and the inhabitants thereof are begotten sons and daughters unto God. VerseEnd

Verse25 And this we saw also and bear record — that an angel of God who was in authority in the presence of God, who rebelled against the Only Begotten Son (whom the Father loved, who was in the bosom of the Father), was thrust down from the presence of God and the Son, VerseEnd Verse26 and was called Perdition, for the Heavens wept over him. He was Lucifer, a Son of the Morning, and VerseEnd Verse27 we beheld and lo, he is fallen, is fallen, even a Son of the Morning. VerseEnd Verse28 And while we were yet in the spirit, the Lord commanded us that we should write the vision, for we beheld Satan, that old serpent, even the Devil, who rebelled against God and sought to take the kingdom of our God and his Christ. VerseEnd Verse29 Wherefore, he makes war with the saints of God and encompasses them round about, VerseEnd Verse30 and we saw a vision of the sufferings of those with whom he made war and overcame.

For thus came the voice of the Lord unto us VerseEnd — Verse31 Thus says the Lord concerning all those who know my power and have been made partakers thereof, and suffered themselves through the power of the Devil to be overcome, unto the denying of the truth and the defying of my power: VerseEnd Verse32 They are they who are the sons of Perdition, of whom I say it had been better for them to have never been born, VerseEnd Verse33 for they are vessels of wrath, doomed to suffer the wrath of God with the Devil and his angels through all eternity, VerseEnd Verse34 concerning whom I have said, There is no forgiveness in this world nor in the world to come, VerseEnd Verse35 having denied the holy spirit, and having denied the Only Begotten Son of the Father, having crucified him unto themselves and put him to an open shame. VerseEnd Verse36 These are they who shall go away into the lake of fire and brimstone with the Devil and his angels, VerseEnd Verse37 and the only ones on whom the second death shall have any power, VerseEnd Verse38 yea, truly, the only ones who shall not be redeemed in the due time of the Lord, after the sufferings of his wrath, VerseEnd Verse39 who shall be brought forth by the resurrection of the dead through the triumph and glory of the Lamb who was slain, who was in the bosom of the Father before the worlds were made. VerseEnd

Verse40 And this is the gospel, the glad tidings which the voice out of the Heavens bore record unto us: VerseEnd Verse41 that he came into the world, even Jesus, to be crucified for the world, and to bear the sins of the world, and to sanctify the world, and to cleanse it from all unrighteousness, VerseEnd Verse42 that through him all might be saved whom the Father had put into his power and made, by him VerseEnd Verse43 who glorifies the Father and saves all the works of his hands, except those sons of Perdition who deny the Son after the Father has revealed him. VerseEnd Verse44 Wherefore, he saves all except them. And they shall go away into everlasting punishment, which is Endless punishment, which is Eternal punishment, to reign with the Devil and his angels in eternity, where their worm dies not and the fire is not quenched, which is their torment. VerseEnd Verse45 And the end thereof, neither the place thereof, nor their torment, no man knows, VerseEnd Verse46 neither was it revealed, neither is, neither will be revealed, unto none except to them who are made partakers thereof. VerseEnd Verse47 Nevertheless, I, the Lord, show it by vision unto many, but straightway shut it up again. VerseEnd Verse48 Wherefore, the end, the width, the height, the depth, and the misery thereof he understands not, neither any man except them who are ordained unto this condemnation. VerseEnd Verse49 And we heard the voice saying, Write the vision, for lo, this is the end of the vision of the sufferings of the ungodly. VerseEnd
Verse50 And again we bear record, for we saw and heard, and this is the testimony of the gospel of Jesus Christ concerning them who come forth in the resurrection of the just: VerseEnd

Verse51 They are they who received the testimony of Jesus and believed on his name, and were baptized after the manner of his burial, being buried in the water in his name, and this according to the commandment which he has given, VerseEnd Verse52 that by keeping the commandments they might be washed and cleansed from all their sins, and receive the holy ghost by the laying on of the hands of him who is ordained and sealed unto this power, VerseEnd Verse53 and who overcome by faith and are sealed by that Holy Spirit of Promise, which the Father sheds forth upon all those who are just and true. VerseEnd
Verse54 They are they who are the church of the Firstborn. VerseEnd
Verse55 They are they into whose hands the Father has given all things. VerseEnd

Verse56 They are they who are priests and kings, who, having received of his fullness and of his glory, VerseEnd Verse57 are priests of the Most High after the order of Melchizedek, which was after the order of Enoch, which was after the Order of the Only Begotten Son. VerseEnd Verse58 Wherefore, as it is written, they are gods, even the sons of God. VerseEnd Verse59 Wherefore, all things are theirs, whether life or death, or things present or things to come, all are theirs and they are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s. VerseEnd Verse60 And they shall overcome all things. VerseEnd Verse61 Wherefore, let no man glory in man, but rather let them glory in God who shall subdue all enemies under his feet. VerseEnd
Verse62 These shall dwell in the presence of God and his Christ for ever and ever. VerseEnd
Verse63 These are they whom he shall bring with him when he shall come in the clouds of Heaven to reign on the earth over his people. VerseEnd
Verse64 These are they who shall have part in the first resurrection. VerseEnd
Verse65 These are they who shall come forth in the resurrection of the just. VerseEnd
Verse66 These are they who are come unto Mount Zion, and unto the city of the living God, the Heavenly place, the holiest of all. VerseEnd
Verse67 These are they who have come to an innumerable company of angels, to the general assembly and church of Enoch, and of the Firstborn. VerseEnd
Verse68 These are they whose names are written in Heaven, where God and Christ are the judge of all. VerseEnd
Verse69 These are they who are just men made perfect through Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, who wrought out this perfect atonement through the shedding of his own blood. VerseEnd

Verse70 These are they whose bodies are Celestial, whose glory is that of the sun, even the glory of God, the highest of all, whose glory the sun of the firmament is written of as being typical. VerseEnd

Verse71 And again, we saw the terrestrial world, and behold and lo, these are they who are of the terrestrial, whose glory differs from that of the church of the Firstborn who have received the fullness of the Father, even as that of the moon differs from the sun of VerseEnd Verse72 the firmament. Behold, these are they who died without law, VerseEnd Verse73 and also they who are the spirits of men kept in prison, whom the Son visited, and preached the gospel unto them that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, VerseEnd Verse74 who received not the testimony of Jesus in the flesh, but afterwards received it. VerseEnd Verse75 These are they who are honorable men of the earth who were blinded by the craftiness of men. VerseEnd Verse76 These are they who receive of his glory, but not of his fullness. VerseEnd Verse77 These are they who receive of the presence of the Son, but not of the fullness of the Father. VerseEnd Verse78 Wherefore, they are bodies terrestrial and not bodies Celestial, and differs in glory as the moon differs from the sun. VerseEnd Verse79 These are they who were not valiant in the testimony of Jesus, wherefore, they obtained not the crown over the kingdoms of our God. VerseEnd Verse80 And now this is the end of the vision which we saw of the terrestrial that the Lord commanded us to write while we were yet in the spirit. VerseEnd

Verse81 And again, we saw the glory of the telestial, which glory is that of the lesser, even as the glory of the stars differs from that of the glory of the moon in the firmament. VerseEnd Verse82 These are they who receive not the gospel of Christ, neither the testimony of Jesus. VerseEnd Verse83 These are they who deny not the holy ghost. VerseEnd Verse84 These are they who are thrust down to hell. VerseEnd Verse85 These are they who shall not be redeemed from the Devil until the last resurrection, until the Lord, even Christ the Lamb, shall have finished his work. VerseEnd Verse86 These are they who receive not of his fullness in the Eternal world, but of the holy ghost through the ministration of the terrestrial, VerseEnd Verse87 and the terrestrial through the ministration of the Celestial. VerseEnd Verse88 And also the telestial receive it of the administering of angels who are appointed to minister for them, or who are appointed to be ministering spirits for them, for they shall be heirs of salvation. VerseEnd Verse89 And thus we saw in the Heavenly vision the glory of the telestial, which surpasses all understanding, VerseEnd Verse90 and no man knows it except him to whom God has revealed it. VerseEnd

Verse91 And thus we saw the glory of the terrestrial, which excels in all things the glory of the telestial, even in glory, and in power, and might, and in dominion. VerseEnd Verse92 And thus we saw the glory of the Celestial, which excels in all things, where God, even the Father, reigns upon his throne for ever and ever; VerseEnd Verse93 before whose throne all things bow in humble reverence, and give him glory for ever and ever. VerseEnd Verse94 They who dwell in his presence are the church of the Firstborn, and they see as they are seen and know as they are known, having received of his fullness and of his grace, VerseEnd Verse95 and he makes them equal in power, and in might, and in dominion. VerseEnd

Verse96 And the glory of the Celestial is one, even as the glory of the sun is one. VerseEnd Verse97 And the glory of the terrestrial is one, even as the glory of the moon is one. VerseEnd Verse98 And the glory of the telestial is one, even as the glory of the stars are one, for as one star differs from another star in glory, even so differs one from another in glory in the telestial world. VerseEnd Verse99 For these are they who are of Paul, and of Apollos, and of Cephas. VerseEnd Verse100 These are they who say they are some of one and some of another: some of Christ, and some of John, and some of Moses, and some of Elias, and some of Esaias, and some of Isaiah, and some of Enoch, VerseEnd Verse101 but received not the gospel, neither the testimony of Jesus, neither the prophets, neither the everlasting covenants. VerseEnd

Verse102 Last of all, these all are they who will not be gathered with the saints, to be caught up unto the church of the Firstborn and received into the cloud. VerseEnd Verse103 These are they who are liars, and sorcerers, and adulterers, and whoremongers, and whosoever loves and makes a lie. VerseEnd Verse104 These are they who suffer the wrath of God on the earth. VerseEnd Verse105 These are they who suffer the vengeance of Eternal fire. VerseEnd Verse106 These are they who are cast down to hell and suffer the wrath of Almighty God, until the fullness of times, when Christ shall have subdued all enemies under his feet, and shall have perfected his work, VerseEnd Verse107 when he shall deliver up the kingdom and present it unto the Father, spotless, saying, I have overcome and have trodden the winepress alone, even the winepress of the fierceness of the wrath of Almighty God. VerseEnd Verse108 Then shall he be crowned with the crown of his glory, to sit on the throne of his power, to reign for ever and ever. VerseEnd

Verse109 But behold, and lo, we saw the glory and the inhabitants of the telestial world, that they were in number as innumerable as the stars in the firmament of heaven, or as the sand upon the seashore, VerseEnd Verse110 and heard the voice of the Lord saying, These all shall bow the knee, and every tongue shall confess to him who sits upon the throne for ever and ever, VerseEnd Verse111 for they shall be judged according to their works, and every man shall receive according to his own works and his own dominion in the mansions which are prepared, VerseEnd Verse112 and they shall be servants of the Most High, but where God and Christ dwell they cannot come, worlds without end. VerseEnd Verse113 This is the end of the vision that we saw which we were commanded to write while we were yet in the spirit. VerseEnd

Verse114 But great and marvelous are the works of the Lord, and the mysteries of his kingdom which he shewed unto us, which surpasses all understanding, in glory, and in might, and in dominion, VerseEnd Verse115 which he commanded us we should not write while we were yet in the spirit, and are not lawful for men to utter, VerseEnd Verse116 neither is man capable to make them known, for they are only to be seen and understood by the power of the holy spirit, which God bestows on those who love him and purifies themselves before him, VerseEnd Verse117 to whom he grants the privilege of seeing and knowing for themselves, VerseEnd Verse118 that through the power and manifestation of the spirit, while in the flesh, they may be able to bear his presence in the world of glory. VerseEnd
Verse119 And to God and the Lamb be glory, and honor, and dominion, for ever and ever. Amen. VerseEnd
